craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). We-mirror kept 1st-plural per UNC (vimṛśāmaḥ); fancy-never-catches close. Rejected: (a) I-mirror → killed by UNC: we reflect together. Read aloud: THERE, CON-cept-FREE … NEV-er FAN-cy's-CATCH, the-TRUE.

lines: we mirror: what, though a jot? Never fancy's catch, the true.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrāvikalpam eva tvāṃ cidrūpaṃ samāviśya | vimṛśāmaḥ kim api manāṅ na hi tattvaṃ kalpanāviṣayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What reflects concept-free? → Entered concept-free, we reflect: fancy never principle.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
